llm.summary: This skill makes a disclosed, reversible local UI patch to OpenClaw's model picker and does not show evidence of credential access, exfiltration, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The file modifications are scoped to the OpenClaw Control UI dist directory and assets matching pcl-model-picker.v*.js, which is proportionate to the UI patch purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation appends or replaces one script tag in index.html, copies one versioned JS asset, backs up the original index.html, and provides a -Remove uninstall path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly instructs the user to run a local patch script and documents the modified files; it also describes automatic same-origin update checks, though one disclosure line overstates this as 'no network access'.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The patch persists until OpenClaw is upgraded or the uninstall switch is run, and the injected browser script periodically performs same-origin update checks and may reload the page; this is disclosed and bounded.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a two-column OpenClaw Control UI model picker, and the included PowerShell installer plus browser script implement that UI change.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the skill modify your local OpenClaw Control UI files. Review the patch path, use -Dist for nonstandard installs, and keep the -Remove command available if you want to undo the UI injection.
